body: In 2023, the Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana Cuajimalpa Campus faced a serious case of dating violence among its students
After this, the university created a specialized unit to support students, along with prevention materials
Even so, a tool was still needed that would connect with young people and help them recognize these situations on their own

sections.title: Looking for a tool that would connect with young people

body: After talking with students and reviewing the literature, we identified that a video game could appeal to them, finding that games are accessible and make possible to learn attitudes

body.caption: Screenshot of video games from the organization Jennifer Ann's Group, showing the use of video games against violence

body: Collaborated with an interdisciplinary team of Design and Communication in creating 'Latencia', a visual novel to help identify dating violence
To represent the problem accurately, we interviewed students about their experiences and reviewed the content with experts on the subject

body.caption: Interviewing a student at the university

sections.title: Designing and developing a video game

body: Led the project and implemented an agile methodology to make steady progress and find problems early in development
Facilitated co-design sessions with young people at different stages of development to gather feedback and incorporate new ideas into the game
Designed and implemented the wireframes, as well as the game documentation to guide its design and implementation
Implemented the game for multiple platforms, ensuring it works on mobile devices, computers, and web environments
Collaborated on the evaluation of the game with 44 young people and 3 experts through interviews, questionnaires, and analysis of recordings of their interaction with the game
More than 70% of the people who evaluated the game approved it, positively highlighting its gameplay and story
The results of one of the questionnaires showed a greater ability to identify situations of violence in relationships after playing
Identified opportunities for improvement, such as depicting more situations of violence and offering more response options in the game's decisions
